rules: No conversation. Write code only. Minimal explanations.
Use named exports only — no default exports.
Use @/ path alias for all internal imports.
No fetch in components — use services/ or store actions.
Financial numbers as raw number, formatted only at display layer.
Variance colors: favorable = green (#16A34A), unfavorable = red (#DC2626).
No any — use unknown for untrusted input.
Zustand stores use subscribeWithSelector > persist > immer middleware order.
Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones.
Run lint after changes: npm run lint
Run typecheck after changes: npx tsc --noEmit
